title: jrsctl runs abandon --yes --json (issue #350, ADR-0066): a pending run closed as it stands

completed.description: Steps whose last journal state is SUCCEEDED or SKIPPED.

interrupted.description: Steps last seen PENDING, RUNNING or FAILED.

rolledBack.description: Steps last seen ROLLED_BACK or ROLLBACK_FAILED.

notStarted.description: Steps of the stored plan the journal never reached.

serviceLeftStopped.description: The run's last service step to succeed stopped the service.
